description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Tri-Element Mode II (Fire, Ice, Lightning)] and [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode I (Steiner v2)] to the user, grants [Spellblade Resonance +3% Boost] to all Spellblade allies
